name: Community JAS-39C Gripen
summary: Community-built flyable Saab JAS-39C Gripen for DCS World with A/A and A/G variants.
description:
Open community mod adding the JAS-39C Gripen with its own cockpit, liveries and weapons. Copy the `Mods` folder from the archive into `Saved Games\DCS`. The A/A variants (F-15C / Su-33 based) need Flaming Cliffs 3; the A/G variant (Su-25T avionics) does not.

Requires: A/A BVR (F-15C based) and A/A WVR (Su-33 based) variants require Flaming Cliffs 3; the A/G variant works without it.

authors.name: Community JAS-39 team (Whisky Actual et al.)

releases.changelog: Adds RWR on HUD, basic nav system, HMD brightness; fixes HMD, GBU drops and an MP crash.
